IVolP: weights proportional to 1/volatility, caps by ajustar_aos_tetos (Palomar ch. 6)
MDivP: max Sharpe with mu = volatilities and rf 0, at most 10 names, caps (Palomar ch. 6)
MDecP: minimum variance on the correlation matrix, divided by the volatilities, caps by ajustar_aos_tetos (Palomar ch. 6)
RPP: equal risk contribution, long-only, cyclical coordinate descent, caps by ajustar_aos_tetos (Palomar ch. 11)

Mean-CVaR: max w'mu - CVaR(0.90) per period, LP on the training rows, at most 10 names, caps (Palomar ch. 10)
Mean-CDaR: max w'mu - CDaR(0.90) per period, uncompounded drawdowns, LP, at most 10 names, caps (Palomar ch. 10)
MVSK: CRRA gamma 1 weights (1, 1/2, 1/3, 1/4), scenario moments, sequential convex steps from 1/N, at most 20, at most 10 names, caps (Palomar ch. 9)
Robust-MV: max w'mu - kappa ||S^(1/2) w|| - (1/2) w'Sigma w, S = Sigma/T, kappa 1, at most 10 names, caps (Palomar ch. 14)
